title: Lecture Circuit 1
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael prepares to go on a lecture circuit with Pam, sharing sales tips while dealing with office dynamics. Kelly is upset about her forgotten birthday, leading to tension with Jim. Michael awkwardly interacts with Karen and introduces Pam to Rolando. Meanwhile, Andy tries to impress Julia, culminating in an awkward but bonding moment. Michael also contemplates seeking closure from a past relationship, deciding to skip a lecture to pursue it with Pam's support.
